import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
export default function BackToTop(){const [show,setShow]=useState(false);useEffect(()=>{const f=()=>setShow(window.scrollY>500);window.addEventListener("scroll",f,{passive:true});return()=>window.removeEventListener("scroll",f)},[]);return show?<button className="back-top" onClick={()=>window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:"smooth"})}>↑</button>:null}
